# Faulkner County Election Commission

> > Official election administration website for Faulkner County, Arkansas, providing voter registration, election information, and polling resources.

The Faulkner County Election Commission oversees elections across Conway, Greenbrier, Mayflower, and Vilonia. The commission manages voter registration, early voting locations, poll worker recruitment, and election administration in accordance with Arkansas state law.

## Key Topics

- Faulkner County
- Arkansas elections

## Elections & Voting

- [Faulkner County Election Commission](https://www.votefaulknerar.gov): Homepage for Faulkner County Election Commission in Arkansas
- [Upcoming Elections](https://www.votefaulknerar.gov/upcoming-elections): Elections calendar for Conway, Greenbrier, Mayflower, and Vilonia areas
- [General Runoff Election December 3, 2024](https://www.votefaulknerar.gov/upcoming-elections/december-runoff): December 2024 runoff election details for Conway Ward 2
- [Upcoming Meetings](https://www.votefaulknerar.gov/upcoming-elections/upcoming-meetings): Election Commission meetings schedule at McGee Center and other venues

## Election Commission

- [Election Commissioners](https://www.votefaulknerar.gov/election-commission): Faulkner County election commissioners including Dixon, Fairless, Pickett
- [Contact](https://www.votefaulknerar.gov/contact): Contact information for Faulkner County election office

## Poll Workers

- [Poll Worker Qualifications](https://www.votefaulknerar.gov/poll-workers/132-2): Arkansas poll worker eligibility requirements under state law
- [2023 Poll Worker Compensation and Requirements](https://www.votefaulknerar.gov/poll-workers/2023-poll-worker-compensation-and-requirements): Poll worker pay rates and requirements per Arkansas statute A.C.A. §7-4-112
